filter.comment: Episode = one cropped CLIP (~15484). Clip filename = <SESSION>-<startMs>-<endMs>-F<startFrame>-F<endFrame>.mp4. SESSION (e.g. OP01-R01-PastaSalad) is the parent dir and the gaze key; the F<start>-F<end> range slices the session gaze. fps=24, frame 1280x960.

projection.notes: Per-SESSION gaze (full untrimmed recording); frame col indexes the full session. A clip's gaze = session rows with frame in [startFrame, endFrame] from the clip filename. Pixels at 1280x960; normalize by frame_dims. gaze_type (Fixation/Saccade/Blink/etc.) preserved. 69 clips (in OP01-R06-GreekSalad, OP03-R01-PastaSalad, OP03-R07-Pizza) have empty gaze slices per gaze_readme -> warn.

join.comment: CSV is semicolon-delimited. Clip Prefix = <SESSION>-<startMs>-<endMs> = clip filename minus the -F..-F.. suffix -> exactly one row per clip. Starting/Ending Time(ms) equal the clip filename's first two numbers. 'Video Session' is the session id. Verb/Noun labels not preserved.

anchor.detail: clip is a trimmed segment; t=0 is the clip's first frame. Gaze already sliced+rebased to clip-relative; annotation ms are session-absolute and must subtract the clip start.

gaze.note: gaze reader already slices session gaze to the clip frame range and rebases to [0, clip_dur]

annotations.from: clip filename start_ms/1000 (== row Starting Time(ms)/1000)

metadata.notes: No metadata file; readme says source 1280x960 @ 24 fps. gaze_readme.md at gaze/gaze_data/gaze_readme.md; action readme at annotations/action_annotation_readme.md. Splits: annotations/train_split{1,2,3}.txt + test_split{1,2,3}.txt (VideoName=full clip stem incl frame range). Bundled gaze_io_sample.py (Python2) is the reference parser.

provenance.notes: METADATA none. VIDEO dataset/video/cropped_clips/ (split clips per session subdir). GAZE dataset/gaze/gaze_data/gaze_data/ (.txt per session; readme at gaze/gaze_data/gaze_readme.md). ANNOTATION dataset/annotations/raw_annotations/action_labels.csv (Video Session, Starting/Ending Time(ms), Action Label; no split noun/verb). NOTE: video files are split inside each session subdir; ensure mapping to session gaze + annotation makes sense.
decisions: Episode = clip (not session); join clip->one CSV row by 'Clip Prefix'.
Gaze is per-session; a clip's gaze = session rows with frame in the clip's [startFrame,endFrame].
Two BeGaze on-disk formats handled via gaze_format.variants (7-col v3.1 for OPxx; 26-col v3.4 with HH:MM:SS:FF timecode for P16+).
Pixels 1280x960 @ 24 fps; preserve gaze_type; single annotation channel 'action'.
corrections: Gaze readme is inside gaze_data/ (gaze/gaze_data/gaze_readme.md); the .txt files are one level deeper in gaze_data/gaze_data/.
Join key is the ready-made 'Clip Prefix' column (unique), not 'Video Session' + time match.
Effective fps is 24 (the gaze header '## Sample Rate: 30' is the eye-tracker rate, not the frame rate).
Two gaze formats require version branching.
open_questions: 69 clips have empty gaze slices (documented in gaze_readme); confirm warn-and-emit (still have video+anno) vs require non-empty gaze. NOTE: under the global emit policy (require gaze), an empty gaze slice may need to count as 'gaze present' since the session file exists.
ms->frame relation has ~5-frame slack; trust the F<start>-F<end> numbers for gaze bounds, not recomputation from ms.
